outcome: A supervised agent-tool run can crash and resume the same semantic attempt: same worktree identity, same tool session, same Core session and same candidate sha, without minting a second lineage or changing the source repository.
currentProblem: Executed probe: runSupervisedTask always mkdtemp, uses sessionId agent-task:${id}:${randomUUID()}, and disposes the worktree in finally. There is no resumeWorktree option, so process death loses the worktree even though Core journals each RUN_AGENT_TOOL ACT.
constraints: Recovery reuses the same AGENT_TASK_V1 identity, worktree path, tool sessionRef and Core sessionId; it cannot start a second semantic attempt for that task id while a durable handle is current.
Default runSupervisedTask without a recovery handle remains byte-identical, including worktree disposal.
Sandbox isolation remains BB-067; observation traces remain BB-098 and must be passed through when present.
Research only in this lane: no product source edits, no self-issued readiness or fabricated Jev judgment.
Every input is labeled DELIVERED_TRUTH, PLANNED_CONTRACT or RESEARCH_DESIRED_STATE; planned contracts are never described as delivered.
successCriteria: Specify a durable AGENT_TOOL_RUN_HANDLE_V1 recording task id, worktree path, base revision, candidate sha, Core sessionId, tool id/version, tool sessionRef, attempt index and handle digest.

Specify crash-after-ACT resume that reopens the same worktree, resumes the tool session when the adapter supports it, continues the same Core session, and never creates a second candidate lineage for that handle.
Specify fail-closed behavior: missing worktree, digest mismatch, source HEAD drift, or a newer handle for the same task id refuses resume rather than starting a fresh mkdtemp run.
Specify that an unrecovered default run still disposes its worktree, plus Living docs for the recovery contract.
Ground the design in the executed productization probe and Core effect-journal behavior and produce an exact file-level plan, negative cases and executable verification for fresh Jev readiness.
